content: A true warrior bears his battle scars as the sacred jewelry of honor.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
explanation: The only shield with zero dents is the shield that was hidden beneath the bed while comrades bled in the field. The scars you carry from defending truth, protecting loved ones, or surviving catastrophic illness are not disfigurements; they are the medals of your soul.
practicalInsight: Stop feeling embarrassed by your emotional or physical scars. Wear your survival as proof of your resilient courage.
reflectionPrompt: What deep wound from your past have you tried to hide, forgetting that it testifies to your survival?
